name: @pipobscure/bundle
description: Record what an application reads, archive it, sign it with sigstore, verify it, and mount it as a verifying node:vfs provider so only signed archives run.
author: Philipp Dunkel <pip@pipobscure.com>

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && node --no-warnings --experimental-vfs --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.audit:cli: node --no-warnings --experimental-vfs dist/main.js audit --baseline build/baseline.run --verdict build/cli.audit.json build/cli.run
scripts.approve:cli: node --no-warnings --experimental-vfs dist/main.js audit --approve --baseline build/baseline.run --verdict build/cli.audit.json build/cli.run
scripts.sign:cli: node --no-warnings --experimental-vfs dist/main.js audit --check --baseline build/baseline.run --verdict build/cli.audit.json build/cli.run && node --no-warnings dist/main.js sign --launcher --output bundle.nzip build/cli.run
scripts.sign:cli:local: npm run testpki && node --no-warnings --experimental-vfs dist/main.js audit --check --baseline build/baseline.run --verdict build/cli.audit.json build/cli.run && node --no-warnings dist/main.js sign --launcher --key build/certs/leaf.key --chain build/certs/chain.pem --output bundle.nzip build/cli.run
scripts.release:cli: npm run build && npm run manifest:cli && npm run pack:cli && npm run baseline:cli && npm run audit:cli
